verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a localhost API, a headless CLI, an official MCP server and an agents skill. That makes credential scoping a fair axis for this product. However, nothing in the pack describes issuing API keys with limited permissions, per-space or read-only scopes, or least-privilege controls. The skill docs' claim of a "safe way" for AI assistants to read and modify Objects is too vague to count as scoped credentials.
